channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Pair Of Maple Leafs Defensemen Would Fetch The Best Return For Toronto
item.description: The struggling Toronto Maple Leafs need to trade many veterans by this year's trade deadline. Moving defensemen Oliver Ekman-Larsson and Brandon Carlo are going to get the Leafs the biggest return.

item.title: Report: Extension Is Key In Trade For Rangers' Panarin, Several Teams In The Mix
item.description: There are plenty of suitors who are interested in acquiring Artemi Panarin from the New York Rangers. However, the player would like an extension tied to a potential trade, and fewer teams are fit for that.

item.title: 'No Change': Auston Matthews And Maple Leafs Reaffirmed Commitment
item.description: With Elliotte Friedman's latest reports on 'Saturday Headlines,' it seems that the Toronto Maple Leafs and captain Auston Matthews are on great terms regarding a future contract extension.

item.title: Five NHL Players Who Have The Most To Prove At The Olympics
item.description: Five NHL players who have the most to prove at the upcoming 2026 Winter Olympics in Milan. Some will look to change their own narrative, while others will want to snap out of poor form on the international stage.

item.title: NHL Waivers: Oilers Place Pickard On The Wire, Flames Waive Kirkland
item.description: The Edmonton Oilers have placed beloved goaltender Calvin Pickard on waivers, while the Calgary Flames put center Justin Kirkland on the wire.

item.title: Say What? Ice Surface Gets Negative Reviews Ahead Of Outdoor Game Between Lightning And Bruins
item.description: Montreal Canadiens' Nick Suzuki doing everything on — and off — the ice to prove why he's been the right choice for captain. Plus, GM Bill Guerin reacts to Olympic snubs and Alex Tuch on why making the playoffs is no longer the goal for the Buffalo Sabres.

item.title: Why Canada And USA Snubbed Some Elite Offense For The Olympics?
item.description: Team Canada and Team USA have left off some serious offensive talent for the upcoming 2026 Olympics. But what was the reasoning behind both GMs' decisions?

item.title: Time For Red Wings GM Steve Yzerman To Make His Biggest Splash
item.description: The Detroit Red Wings have had a terrific season thus far this year, but the opportunity to improve via a major trade is there for the taking for GM Steve Yzerman. He's got a massive amount of cap space, so it's time for Yzerman to step up and make a blockbuster move.

item.title: 2025-26 NHL Fantasy Hockey Week 18 Primer and Pickups: Olympic Break Throws Wrench In Schedule
item.description: The NHL fantasy schedule will be thrown in a blender with the Olympic break coming up. Here's the best approach to tackle Week 18.

item.title: WATCH: Vasilevskiy And Swayman Drop The Gloves In Stadium Series Goalie Fight
item.description: Tampa Bay Lightning's Andrei Vasilevskiy and Boston Bruins' Jeremy Swayman drop the gloves in a goalie fight during the second period of the Stadium Series matchup at Raymond James Stadium.
